message.content: During LLM decoding, each generated token usually requires reading large model weights and the KV cache from VRAM, so the process is often memory-bandwidth-bound rather than compute-bound. Higher VRAM bandwidth lets the GPU move this data faster, directly increasing tokens-per-second and reducing latency.
